text:
Maria: Quick sync — need to lock a slot for an inference perf readout focused on latency/cost dashboards + benchmark results. Proposed slots next week: Tue 10–11am PT, Wed 4–5pm PT, Fri 9–10am PT. Draft agenda: 1) baseline numbers (p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, $/1M tokens), 2) quantization & KV-cache experiments, 3) routing/fallback cost impact, 4) Dedicated pool queuing, 5) rollouts & action items. Please vote with :one: :two: :three: and add agenda items or owners.

Kevin: :one: for the time. Can we include a short comparison streaming vs batched throughput? I can bring GPU utilization and kernel-level heatmaps.

Sophie: :two: but I prefer earlier in the week if possible. Add: quick readout of Dedicated reserved pool queuing and tail latencies (we've seen weird spikes last week).

Raj: :one: I can prep p99 traces and a minimal repro script. Where do folks want artifacts? I'll drop bench logs and raw traces somewhere.

Olivia: :one: or :two:, either works. I'll cover cost breakdown (token-level billing from Redwood Console) and a short $/hour vs $/1M tokens comparison for quantized variants.

Kevin: quick ask — what workload/dataset should we use for the readout? Realistic conversational prompt set or synthetic long-form? I can run both but need to know which to prioritize.

Maria: Let's prioritize the conv prompt set (prod-like) for the baseline, plus one synthetic long sequence to highlight memory/KV behavior. Pre-reads: perf table export + a short README. Drop links in this thread.

Raj: I'll drop artifacts to the eng-ml perf folder and link here. Sample run command I'll use:
```bash
# run latency sweep
python perf/runner.py --model redwood-v2-small --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --seq-lens 64,256,1024 --out logs/run_1767 --streaming false
```
Outputs: token rates, p50/p95/p99, GPU util, kv-cache hit ratio.

Sophie: I can capture Dedicated pool queue metrics; will add an exported heatmap and a short note about autoscaler interactions. Also want to validate canary fallback behavior under surge.

Olivia: Will add cost breakdown slides and the ledger export. Also confirm: do we want to show cost impact of different quantization (8-bit vs 4-bit) plus quality notes?

Kevin: yes please — pair those with latency tradeoffs and perf-per-dollar chart.

ci-bot: poll created by Maria: "Perf readout slot" — vote results will be visible here: https://internal.polls/1767123456

Maria: Ok locking Tue 10–11am PT. Pre-reads due Mon EOD PT. Owners: Kevin (metrics + streaming vs batch), Raj (bench scripts, traces, artifacts), Olivia (cost breakdown), Sophie (Dedicated queuing + canary fallback). Please drop links to PRs/datasets/dashboards here. Agenda will be 30m readouts + 20m triage/discussion + 10m action items.

Kevin: I'll post a dashboard link and a short CSV export by Monday.

Raj: uploaded logs to eng-ml/perf/176712; dashboard link: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/eng-ml/perf/176712 (raw traces + run artifacts). Note: there's a flaky config in runner v0.9 — see PR #482.

Maria: thanks. Quick follow-ups: 1) Sophie can you add the Dedicated pool name & region to the pre-read? 2) Olivia, add the estimated $ delta for quant configs. 3) Kevin, include kernel-level heatmaps (png) if you can.

Sophie: noted, will add pool details (us-west-2, reserved-pool-7) and a short note on autoscaler settings.

Olivia: will include $ delta + assumptions (token mix, request mix).

Maria: Great — see you Tue 10am PT. I'll post a calendar invite with dial-in and agenda in the thread. If anyone needs to swap owners, ping me here. :thumbsup:
